# The mod's screens after fix/crash192, which wraps every method the game calls on them (drawing, narration, keys,
# clicks, closing) so an error closes the screen with a "Something went wrong, try again" pop-up instead of ending the
# game. Nothing in a working game changes: this checks that the settings, the song library and the tour still draw,
# take keys and clicks, and close as before. Minecraft 1.21.11, 1280x720, GUI scale 3 (426x240), the demo song. Every
# shot is the SAME on the branch and on main; the game log of the branch run must have no "Error in the settings",
# "Error in the song library" or "Error in the tour" line (and no pop-up shows in any shot).
# - crash192-tour-0, -1, -2: the tour's first three pages (Show me around, then Next), as tour.txt shows them.
# - crash192-tour-closed: Esc on the tour: the world, no screen.
# - crash192-settings-look: the settings on the Look tab (gui 1).
# - crash192-settings-next: Ctrl+Tab: the Music tab highlighted in the sidebar.
# - crash192-settings-search: Ctrl+F and "glow" typed: the search results for glow.
# - crash192-settings-closed: Esc (clears the search, back on the Music tab), Esc again: the world, no screen.
# - crash192-library: the song library (grid) after two Down presses: the same card chosen on both.
# - crash192-library-closed: Esc: the world, no screen.
# Run it on the branch, and with -f mod_ref=main for the old code (the script comes from --ref):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/crash192 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/crash192.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/crash192 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/crash192.txt
# The same script on 26.3 and 1.21.1 covers the other two ways the screens are drawn and handed keys.

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
look 0 -20
sleep 6
guiscale 3

screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.IntroScreen
sleep 3
shot crash192-tour-0
click 290 197
sleep 2
shot crash192-tour-1
click 320 197
sleep 1
shot crash192-tour-2
key escape
sleep 2
shot crash192-tour-closed

gui 1
sleep 2
shot crash192-settings-look
key tab ctrl
sleep 1
shot crash192-settings-next
key f ctrl
sleep 0.5
type glow
sleep 1
shot crash192-settings-search
key escape
sleep 0.5
key escape
sleep 2
shot crash192-settings-closed

set libraryView GRID
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
key down
sleep 0.5
key down
sleep 1.5
shot crash192-library
key escape
sleep 2
shot crash192-library-closed
